'''Chirome''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Head Chef]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. He oversaw a capable staff who worked to serve artistically created fine cuisine to the liner's passengers dining in the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] five stately dining rooms.<ref name="RPG" /> His [[Filet of Coslen Dantoinal]] was considered to be exquisite.<ref name="RM">[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']]</ref>
